remarks: Spacious and bright townhouse-style unit featuring an eat-in kitchen with newer range and dishwasher, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The main level offers a large living room with sliding doors leading to a private balcony, a spacious dining room, and a convenient half bath. The second floor features a primary suite with a full bath and two closets, along with two additional generously sized bedrooms and another full bathroom. The finished lower level includes a laundry room and direct access to a one-car garage. This unit offers abundant closet space, one reserved parking space, guest parking, and access to an in-ground pool. Conveniently located near Downtown Stamford, Ridgeway Shopping Center, restaurants, parks, transportation, and major conveniences. Must see!!
